BACKTRACKING CSP
Depth-first search with constraint propagation. Assigns values to cells and backtracks when conflicts are detected.
MRV HEURISTIC
Minimum Remaining Values — always assigns the cell with the fewest legal options first, reducing branching.
FORWARD CHECKING
After each assignment, prunes the domains of all neighbors. Detects dead-ends early before deeper recursion.
